title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Flame Design
objectives: Study how different gaseous-flame compositions and conditions affect soot formation and flame behavior in microgravity.
approach: Use controlled spherical diffusion flames and vary fuel, oxygen/diluent composition, flow and pressure; record diagnostics for comparison.
